page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-64 is an x86_64 architecture server instance featuring 64 dedicated virtual CPUs and 248.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include integrated local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from neighboring instances. However, the lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a tradeoff, making this server less suitable for tasks requiring high-speed local caching or hardware-accelerated parallel processing. Network-attached storage latency will be a factor for I/O-heavy operations.

Given the balanced compute-to-memory ratio of nearly 1:4, this instance is designed for compute-intensive workloads that require substantial processing power but do not demand extreme memory footprints. Suitable applications include web serving, batch processing, application servers, and general-purpose enterprise workloads.
